title: Mosslight Bastion
short_description: Four towers, 60 woodland defenses, and a little light worth protecting.
long_description:
A small keep. A winding woodland lane. One lantern you refuse to let go dark.

Mosslight Bastion is a compact tower defense game about reading a route and making a little budget go a long way. Tap a glowing build pad, choose a guardian, and call the next wave when you are ready.

HOLD THE LANE
Play 60 authored missions across twelve woodland regions, from Fernwake Glen to Elderroot Sanctuary. Visible fixed routes and clear build pads let you plan before the first visitor arrives. Upgrade a useful position, sell a misplaced tower, or save supplies for the next wave.

FOUR TOWERS, A THOUSAND DECISIONS
Archer fires quick, economical shots. Ember catches crowded sporelings with splash damage. Frost slows most foes. Prism reaches far and ignores armor. Runners, armored shellguards, slow-proof wisps and siege brambles ask for different answers.

GROW A LITTLE BASTION INTO A HOME WORTH DEFENDING
Earn keeper XP, campaign stars and coins through ordinary play. Build permanent preparation upgrades, choose a lantern color, collect a seven-day login gift and complete daily action quests. Keep playing an expanding endless siege or a date-seeded daily defense; preparation upgrades are disabled in the daily mode.

PLAY AT YOUR PACE
Pause freely, call waves yourself, use free Rally and retry without paying. The complete game loop works offline. Progress is stored on this device with a previous-valid backup. Unfinished combat is not saved across process death.

OPTIONAL ONLINE FEATURES
Android advertising is optional to ordinary play. An available earned native repair can restore up to eight keep hearts and 40 supplies once per run. Assisted clears keep ordinary rewards but never replace unassisted competitive records. Fullscreen ads leave combat paused until you choose Resume. No reward is invented when an ad is unavailable.

This local test edition uses official Google test ad IDs. Production Play Games achievements and leaderboards require owner configuration. Twenty local achievements and four local record categories remain available without sign-in.
monetization: Free ordinary progression and retries. Home banner; interstitial at natural transition after every 2 completed rounds; optional once/run earned repair. No in-app purchases implemented.
content_rating_notes: Stylized fantasy tower combat, no graphic injury. Intended general audience; owner must complete actual rating and audience declarations.
release_status: Local development package. Not a Google Play publication or eligibility declaration.
